Q9012.reason: A blanket negative belief about a group is an attitude (prejudice); discrimination requires unequal treatment, and the remark is neither ethnocentrism nor conflict theory.

Q9013.reason: Fraudulent misrepresentation requires reliance and pecuniary loss, and the pedestrian rejected the offer and recovered a full verdict, so the lie caused no monetary loss; a fiduciary duty is not an element.

Q9014.reason: Under the prevailing agency theory of felony murder, liability does not attach when a co-felon is killed by a third party such as police rather than by a co-felon.
